resource.name: Making Dallas' Streets Safer
resource.description:
This story map explains how the Office of Data Analytics and Business Intelligence uses GIS applications to draw on data from numerous city departments and the crowdsourced applications Waze and improve transportation within Dallas.
This story map references the applications WAZE Dashboard (arcgis.com) and Traffic Control Permits Dashboard (arcgis.com)

additional_access_points.description:
Dashboard to show Traffic Control Permits in the ROW, and also show Crowd-Sourced WAZE traffic data

This is a dashboard for using the WAZE data

Traffic Control Permits associated with a specific street address. A permit is expected to have only one GIS feature (line or point), but the data may have some anomalies.A Traffic Control Permit is required if construction work in or outside the public right-of-way will result in any closure of a traffic lane, blocking of a sidewalk or alley. The authoritative source for permit information is the Right-of-Way Management System.

resource.name: ROW Permits - Lines
resource.description: Right-of-way-permits that span one or more street blocks. A permit is expected to have only one GIS feature (line or point), but the data may have some anomalies.A permit is required to perform any construction work within the public right-of-way or any construction work outside of the public right-of-way that will cut, break, or otherwise damage the public right-of-way. The authoritative source for permit information is the Right-of-Way Management System (https://rowmanagement.dallascityhall.com/Login.aspx).

resource.name: Permit Points
resource.description:
Residential Permit Activity Points shapefile.

This dataset in the shapefile format contains geo-located points of permits in the City of Dallas for new construction, renovation, alteration, addition, or reconstruction. These data span July 2015 through June 2017 and were used as a primary dataset to generate the Percent New Construction, and Percent Rehabilitation factors in the MVA.
